title: Spotify Skip Rate by Playlist
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player and achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spotify:play
| stats count as plays, sum(eval(skipped="true")) as skips by context_name
| eval skip_rate=round(100*skips/plays,1)
| where plays>=10 AND skip_rate>40
| sort - skip_rate
description: Measures which playlists, radios, or contexts you abandon most often, giving you a brutally honest quality score for your own music curation.
value: Skip behaviour is feedback you do not have to think about; turning it into a metric helps improve playlists and discover what actually fits your mood.
implementation: Forward Spotify playback data with skip markers; review the highest skip-rate contexts and prune or rebuild them.
visualization: Table of playlists by plays, skips, and skip rate.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which playlists you keep skipping through instead of really enjoying.
